summary: Moore delivered remarks at a JCRC of Greater Washington 'Stand with Israel' rally in October 2023 and, as Maryland Governor, called a University of Maryland student vigil for Gaza 'inappropriate' in October 2024. By May 2026 he acknowledged that Netanyahu committed 'war crimes' in Gaza by using food as a negotiating tool, yet stopped short of calling the campaign a genocide and affirmed both Israel's and Palestinians' right to exist.
